Nord Modular G2 Editor

A cross-platform editor for the Nord Modular G2 synthesizer. The original Clavia editor does not run on modern macOS — this editor brings full patch editing to macOS, Windows, and (later) Linux.

Download & Install User Guide

Features

  • Patch editing — add, move, and delete modules and cables
  • Full parameter editing with real-time sync to the G2
  • Performance mode — 4 slots (A–D), 8 variations each
  • Patch and performance browser (disk files + synth memory)
  • Offline mode — edit .pch2 / .prf2 files without a connected G2
  • LED and CPU/memory monitoring

Project Status

Core editing is working. Second-goal features (undo/redo, morphs, MIDI CC) are in progress.

Goal Status
Core USB, parsing, basic patch editing ✅ Done
Undo/Redo, morphs, MIDI CC, parameter pages 🔄 In progress
Patch Adjuster, Mutator, advanced features 🗓 Planned

First proof of concept (30 April 2026)
